integrity_statement: Analytical proof and executable independent-mode residual and exact Brownian-bridge numerical diagnostics accompany the claim; no external audit or independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric gate transition rates, stationary initial gate, independent Poisson reset at a>0, Brownian generator D d²/dx², transparent inactive point target, continuous-time absorption only.
The singular fast-gate limit concerns side-of-detection, not the convergence of mean first-passage time.
The exact formula and monotonicity are established analytically but external validation and exhaustive publication-priority certification have not been performed.
A reported opposite trend in the originating paper’s finite-time-step simulation discussion requires numerical-convention reconciliation.
title: Exact opposite-side detection in a resetting Brownian search with a transparent blinking target
